releaseNotes:
QuizMaster v1.2.0 (Build 147):
- Added 4-Step First-Time Setup Wizard (Welcome, API Key Setup, Appearance/Language & Guide, Smiley Completion Screen)
- Enlarged Windowed Modal Dialogs across the app (740x660 Setup, 680x660 Updates, 680x760 Settings, 720x740 Import, 720x720 AI Sheet)
- Automatic In-App OTA Update Engine with detached background self-replacement & relaunch
- Rendered Markdown Formatted Update Release Notes
- Fixed Question & Option (A/B/C/D) Shuffling in Practice, Exam, and Flashcard modes
- Fixed Flashcard Mode Completion Screen with round summary options
- Added Gatekeeper & Security Setup Documentation in VI and EN
- Added In-App Setup Wizard Re-trigger button in Settings
